Container.Name: FastDAV
Container.Overview: FastDAV - a fast, lightweight, fully compliant WebDAV server (RFC 4918 class 1 + 2, RFC 4331 quotas) with per-device app passwords. Works with Windows Explorer, macOS Finder, Linux, iOS/Android file managers, rclone, Joplin, Obsidian, Zotero, KeePass and more. Encrypted by default (TLS 1.3, hardware AES-GCM / ChaCha20) with an auto-generated certificate. Manage users and app passwords at https://[IP]:[PORT]/.fastdav/

Config.Name: HTTPS Port
Config.Description: Encrypted WebDAV + account page.

Config.Name: Certificate hostnames
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames/IPs you connect with (your Unraid name and LAN IP, plus any DNS name). Put into the auto-generated certificate.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Folder shared over WebDAV. Users' home folders are relative to this.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Users and app passwords (fastdav.json).

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Admin account created on start.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Admin password (min 8 chars). Re-applied on every start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id files are written as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id files are written as (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask (Unraid default 000).

Config.Name: Read only
Config.Description: Make the whole server read-only.

Config.Name: URL prefix
Config.Description: Serve under a sub-path, e.g. /dav (for reverse proxies).

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Use X-Forwarded-For for client IPs (enable only behind a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Max login failures
Config.Description: Failed logins per IP in 5 min before a 15 min block. 0 disables.

Config.Name: Access log
Config.Description: Log every request.

Config.Name: CORS origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated origins allowed for browser-based WebDAV clients, or *.

Config.Name: TLS
Config.Description: auto = HTTPS on (own cert if TLS_CERT/TLS_KEY set, else auto-generated). off = plain HTTP only.

Config.Name: HTTP/2
Config.Description: Offer HTTP/2. Off by default: HTTP/1.1 is 2-3x faster for big WebDAV transfers.

Config.Name: Extra plain-HTTP listener
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. :8080 - unencrypted listener for a reverse proxy that does its own TLS. Map the port too.

Config.Name: TLS certificate
Config.Description: Optional: your own PEM certificate (full chain) inside the container, e.g. a Let's Encrypt fullchain.pem. Reloaded automatically when renewed.

Config.Name: TLS key
Config.Description: Path to the matching PEM private key.
